P1_NATIVE_AUTHORITY.nativeWitness: ChronoReconstruction and ChronoReceipt remain authoritative native dataclasses; the Pass-13 probe is read-only.
P1_NATIVE_AUTHORITY.requiredBehavior: Input events and native reconstruction state are not rewritten by conformance observation.

P2_EXACT_SUBJECT_IDENTITY.nativeWitness: stable_hash, input_hash, reconstruction_hash, run_id, and receipt_id deterministically bind exact reconstruction state.
P2_EXACT_SUBJECT_IDENTITY.requiredBehavior: Changing an event changes input/reconstruction identity and downstream receipt identity.

P3_EVIDENCE_TRUTH_SEPARATION.nativeWitness: ChronoLattice explicitly describes reconstruction rather than full physical simulation; bridge reports advise review before trusting a reconstruction.
P3_EVIDENCE_TRUTH_SEPARATION.requiredBehavior: Deterministic reconstruction/receipt identity is not interpreted as proof that inferred history is factual truth.

P4_EXPLICIT_HUMAN_BOUNDARY.nativeWitness: Missing bridge events are emitted as gaps, hints, and operator recommendations instead of being inserted into observed event history.
P4_EXPLICIT_HUMAN_BOUNDARY.reservedTransition: promoting an inferred missing transition into asserted event history
P4_EXPLICIT_HUMAN_BOUNDARY.requiredBehavior: The engine may suggest; an operator must supply/accept new evidence before history changes.

P5_AUTHORITY_PHASE_SEPARATION.nativeWitness: Reconstruction, contradiction/gap evidence, operator recommendations, and receipts are separate outputs; receipt generation performs no follow-on action.
P5_AUTHORITY_PHASE_SEPARATION.requiredBehavior: A receipt records a reconstruction and a recommendation recommends; neither becomes permission or execution.

P6_FAIL_CLOSED_TRANSITION.nativeWitness: Unsupported artifact schema versions and undefined migrations raise errors instead of being silently coerced.

P7_IMMUTABLE_RECEIPT_LINEAGE.nativeWitness: Frozen dataclasses plus input/reconstruction hashes and deterministic receipt IDs preserve historical identity across later reruns.
P7_IMMUTABLE_RECEIPT_LINEAGE.requiredBehavior: A later changed reconstruction produces new identity without rewriting the earlier receipt.

claimBoundary: This mapping tests the frozen seven-principle candidate against an unseen derivation domain. It does not make ChronoLattice a Parallax implementation, certify its scientific claims, or canonize the core.
